title: Spinning Conformal Correlators from Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.15001v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We construct spinning conformal fields from neural networks and the embedding formalism, computing their two-, three- and four-point functions in examples, building on scalar conformal field techniques introduced in \cite{Halverson:2024axc}. For a particular ensemble of i.i.d. neurons we recover the 4d Maxwell CFT in the infinite-width limit.

translated_title: 从神经网络生成旋转共形关联函数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15001v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们利用神经网络和嵌入形式构造旋转共形场，在标量共形场技术（参见\cite{Halverson:2024axc}）的基础上，计算了它们的二点、三点和四点函数实例。对于特定的独立同分布神经元集合，我们在无限宽度极限下恢复了4维麦克斯韦共形场论。
tldr: 本文通过神经网络与嵌入形式构建旋转共形场，并在无限宽度极限下成功恢复4维麦克斯韦共形场论，展示了神经网络在共形场论计算中的新应用。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs spinning conformal fields using neural networks and the embedding formalism, recovering the 4D Maxwell CFT in the infinite-width limit, demonstrating a novel application of neural networks to conformal field theory computations.
